_doc: One designed look per Emberveil enemy, boss, class pet, hireable companion and named hire. Built by tools/build-emberveil-enemies.mjs — edit the tables there, not this file. Humanoids carry `avatar` (avatar-2d parts, also drives the Mii 3D body); beasts and constructs carry `creature` (avatar-3d/js/creature-types.js). `voiceRole` feeds shared/voices.js voiceFor(); `traits` feed the speech section. The same looks are filed in the library as enemy_<id> / companion_<id>.

goblin_scout.name: Goblin Scout
goblin_scout.desc: Runs ahead of the warband, counts your swords, runs back faster.

goblin_warrior.name: Goblin Warrior
goblin_warrior.desc: Small, loud, and holding a cleaver stolen off a farm three valleys back.

goblin_shaman.name: Goblin Shaman
goblin_shaman.desc: Burns bone and beetle wing, and the fire answers in a voice that is not hers.

goblin_warlord.name: Goblin Warlord
goblin_warlord.desc: Wears three helmets worth of scrap and answers to no chief but the one in the mirror.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.desc: Road tax, he calls it. There is no road and he is not a tax collector.

bandit_captain.name: Bandit Captain
bandit_captain.desc: Keeps a ledger of everyone she has robbed, in case anyone comes back rich.

dragon_cultist.name: Dragon Cultist
dragon_cultist.desc: Believes the burning to come is a kindness, and wants a good seat for it.

veil_cultist.name: Veil Cultist
veil_cultist.desc: Chants into the thin places where the Veil frays, hoping something chants back.

veil_sorcerer.name: Veil Sorcerer
veil_sorcerer.desc: Reads the Veil the way a sailor reads weather, and sails straight into the worst of it.

veil_warden.name: Veil Warden
veil_warden.desc: Stands at the tear in the world and lets nothing through, in either direction.

veilspawn_herald.name: Veilspawn Herald
veilspawn_herald.desc: Announces the Veil the way a bell announces a funeral, and it is never your own.

void_prophet.name: Void Prophet
void_prophet.desc: Blindfolded, because what he sees without the cloth does not need eyes.

abyssal_knight.name: Abyssal Knight
abyssal_knight.desc: Plate the colour of a starless sky, worn by something that gave up breathing centuries ago.

hell_knight.name: Hell Knight
hell_knight.desc: Armour welded shut from the inside, still glowing from the forge that was not a forge.

demon_brute.name: Demon Brute
demon_brute.desc: Four hundred pounds of grievance with horns filed to points for the look of it.

wyrm_warrior.name: Wyrm Warrior
wyrm_warrior.desc: Wears the scales of the wyrm she killed, which the wyrm-cult finds unforgivable.

corrupted_wolf.name: Corrupted Wolf
corrupted_wolf.desc: Ran through a Veil-tear chasing a deer. Only one of them came out, and it was hungrier.

corrupted_bear.name: Corrupted Bear
corrupted_bear.desc: Three seasons past hibernation and still walking, which is the part that worries people.

cinder_hound.name: Cinder Hound
cinder_hound.desc: Leaves pawprints that smoke for an hour. Sleeps in the coals and wakes up hungry.

giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.desc: Webs the size of sails, strung between two trees that used to mark a safe road.

dragon_whelp.name: Dragon Whelp
dragon_whelp.desc: Wings too small to fly, temper large enough to try anyway.

storm_dragon.name: Storm Dragon
storm_dragon.desc: Nests in thunderheads and treats the sky below as a private hunting ground.

frost_wyrm.name: Frost Wyrm
frost_wyrm.desc: Swims through snowpack like water and surfaces where the fire was.

genesis_worm.name: Genesis Worm
genesis_worm.desc: Older than the tunnels it dug. The tunnels are the shape of its appetite.

imp.name: Imp
imp.desc: Too small to kill you, too quick to catch, and it knows both of those things.

molten_golem.name: Molten Golem
molten_golem.desc: Slag and cooling stone, packed around a heart that never finished burning.

primordial_elemental.name: Primordial Elemental
primordial_elemental.desc: First fire, still arguing with first air, in a shape that keeps losing the argument.

reality_shard.name: Reality Shard
reality_shard.desc: A piece of somewhere else, spinning, cutting the air it does not belong to.

star_horror.name: Star Horror
star_horror.desc: Fell out of the wrong constellation and has been looking at us ever since.

cosmic_titan.name: Cosmic Titan
cosmic_titan.desc: Walks the ridge lines at night. From the valley it is mistaken for weather.

ash_wraith.name: Ash Wraith
ash_wraith.desc: What is left when a person burns and the grudge does not.

void_wraith.name: Void Wraith
void_wraith.desc: Robes with nothing in them, moving against the wind on purpose.

void_shade.name: Void Shade
void_shade.desc: Your shadow, if your shadow had opinions about where you should be standing.

grax_veil_touched.name: Grax the Veil-Touched
grax_veil_touched.desc: Reached into a Veil-tear on a dare. The arm came back wrong and so did he.

void_scholar.name: The Void Scholar
void_scholar.desc: Read every book in the vault, then read the vault, then read what the vault was written on.

archfiend_malgrath.name: Archfiend Malgrath
archfiend_malgrath.desc: Signs every bargain himself, in your handwriting, before you have agreed to it.

the_architect.name: The Architect
the_architect.desc: Did not break the world. Drew it this way, and is annoyed that anyone objects.

emberveil_sovereign.name: The Emberveil Sovereign
emberveil_sovereign.desc: Wears the Veil like a coronation robe and expects the burning world to kneel in it.

ancient_dragon.name: Ancient Dragon
ancient_dragon.desc: Older than the kingdom that named it, and it remembers every border the kingdom moved.

dragon_king.name: Bahamorth, the Dragon King
dragon_king.desc: Bahamorth holds court in a caldera and calls the other dragons his subjects. They come.

lava_titan.name: The Lava Titan
lava_titan.desc: Stone outside, furnace inside, and the mountain it climbed out of has not filled back in.

vault_guardian.name: The Vault Guardian
vault_guardian.desc: Sandstone and brass, wound tight around one instruction: nothing leaves the vault.

the_first_ember.name: The First Ember
the_first_ember.desc: The spark every fire is a rumour of, awake and taking it personally.

echo_sovereign.name: Echo of the Sovereign
echo_sovereign.desc: The Sovereign as the Veil remembers it, repeating a coronation that never finished.

the_unraveler.name: The Unraveler
the_unraveler.desc: Pulls one thread out of a thing and waits, politely, for the rest of it to come apart.

pet_wolf.name: Forest Wolf
pet_wolf.desc: Bonded through green magic, not a leash. Walks a pace ahead and picks the path.

pet_bear.name: Cave Bear
pet_bear.desc: Came out of the deep wood when called and has not been asked to leave since.

pet_war_hound.name: Trained War Hound
pet_war_hound.desc: Trained on a rope and a whistle. Knows four commands and ignores the fourth.

pet_demon.name: Infernal Hound
pet_demon.desc: Answers to the pact, not to you, but the pact says it must sit when you say sit.

pet_imp.name: Bound Imp
pet_imp.desc: Bound at the wrist, loyal to the letter of the deal and nothing past it.

pet_familiar.name: Arcane Familiar
pet_familiar.desc: Black cat with rune-light under the fur, older than the mage it agreed to follow.

pet_fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental
pet_fire_elemental.desc: Summoned out of the ember planes and pleased to be somewhere with things to burn.

pet_lightning_elemental.name: Lightning Elemental
pet_lightning_elemental.desc: A bolt that was given a purpose before it finished striking, and kept going.

pet_bone_golem.name: Bone Golem
pet_bone_golem.desc: Every bone in it was donated, in the sense that nobody living objected.

pet_clockwork_turret.name: Clockwork Turret
pet_clockwork_turret.desc: Brass tripod, one blue eye, springs wound tight enough to worry the person winding them.

pet_skeletal_warrior.name: Skeletal Warrior
pet_skeletal_warrior.desc: Fought for somebody once. Still holds the line, and still does not say for whom.

war_dog.name: War Dog
war_dog.desc: Farm dog with a soldier past. Hates goblins on sight and has never explained why.

shadow_cat.name: Shadow Cat
shadow_cat.desc: Black fur, coal eyes, and a habit of arriving behind whatever it was hunting.

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire_wolf.desc: A wolf the size of a horse, with a pack instinct it has decided you belong to.

forest_owl.name: Forest Owl
forest_owl.desc: Silent to the last wingbeat. Sees the ambush two turns before the scout does.

ember_drake.name: Ember Drake
ember_drake.desc: Small enough for a shoulder, hot enough to ruin the shoulder it sits on.

crystal_golem.name: Crystal Golem
crystal_golem.desc: Living crystal, slow as a season, and almost impossible to talk out of a doorway.

spirit_wisp.name: Spirit Wisp
spirit_wisp.desc: A mote of pale light that drifts close when someone is hurt, and warms as it goes.

bone_hound.name: Bone Hound
bone_hound.desc: A mastiff held together by old necromantic thread. Tireless, and entirely unafraid.

ice_sprite.name: Ice Sprite
ice_sprite.desc: A flicker of frost that hangs about head height. The cold it leaves outlasts the fight.

swamp_frog.name: Swamp Frog
swamp_frog.desc: Boulder-sized, sticky-tongued, and far harder to move than anything that green should be.

void_moth.name: Void Moth
void_moth.desc: Wings of starless black. Drifts between the lines of the world and comes back dusted with somewhere else.

dragon_hatchling.name: Crimson Dragon Hatchling
dragon_hatchling.desc: Crimson, hand-sized, and convinced the fire it breathes is already a dragon.

frost_wyrmling.name: Frost Wyrmling
frost_wyrmling.desc: A young frost wyrm, blue-scaled, breathing cold in the shape of a held breath.

storm_drake.name: Storm Drake
storm_drake.desc: Lightning in the wings and thunder a beat behind it, always in a hurry.

shadow_wyrm.name: Shadow Wyrm
shadow_wyrm.desc: Born of eclipse-fire. The dark clings to it, and whispers answer when it calls.

aela.name: Aela
aela.desc: Eastern border ranger. Waits for the shot the way other people wait for weather.

borin.name: Borin
borin.desc: Retired soldier, bored senseless by peace, looking for one more fight to lose slowly.

lysa.name: Lysa
lysa.desc: First posting outside the temple, and determined that nobody notice it is her first.

rekk.name: Rekk
rekk.desc: Says he is not a thief. Carries three knives and a very specific route out of every room.

kaldrek.name: Kaldrek the Dragonborn
kaldrek.desc: Dragon-blooded, dragon-scaled, and unable to finish a sentence without saying dragon.

syra_wyrmsworn.name: Syra Wyrmsworn
syra_wyrmsworn.desc: Sworn to the old wyrm-oaths, which she recites before a fight whether or not anyone is listening.

vorin_emberjaw.name: Vorin Emberjaw
vorin_emberjaw.desc: Raised in a red hoard by a dragon that miscounted its eggs. Still insists he is one of them.

maelis_drakeblood.name: Maelis Drakeblood
maelis_drakeblood.desc: Left the dragon-cult with the tattoos still on. They light up when a wyrm is near, which she hates.

ysolde_cogwright.name: Ysolde Cogwright
ysolde_cogwright.desc: Workshop-trained, brass-goggled, more pockets than fingers, and quicker with a wound than a wrench.
